craft_notes: Sthāyin: grant-joy. Triplet keeps doubling uncut. Close: stainlessness. Rejected: splitting the doubling — killed; 'ignoramus' — killed.

lines: What he desires, desires, swiftly shall he gain;
though unknowing, direct sight he'll attain — all-knowing, no doubt's stain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yān yān kāmayate kāmāṃs tān tāñ cchīghram avāpnuyāt | ajñaḥ pratyakṣatām eti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Whatever desires wished quickly got; the unknowing goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
c1_essence: Desires quickly got; unknowing to direct sight, no doubt.
